meetTips.longComment: First meeting on the Lakeside circuit in a little over a month, with rail shifting back to the true position. Riders were happy to use plenty of the track in the home straight, with winners in lanes 3-11 at the 400m and 2-12 at the 200m. Three of the eight winners settled at margins of 3.2L, 4.6L and 5.7L from the leader at the 800m. All winners were within 2L of the leader at the 400m, and were all leading at the 200m.

formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Slow to begin.  When questioned, rider Beau Mertens reported as a result it settled further back than intended.  He added that when the pace of the race quickened from the 800m, he felt it was too early to place the mare (which was first up) under pressure and as there was no other runner to bring him into the race, he therefore elected to wait until after passing 600m before placing Tempranillo under pressure.

formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground.  Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.  When questioned, rider John Allen reported after beginning awkwardly, the mare settled further back than he would have preferred, adding that near the 900m when awkwardly positioned between runners, he was obliged to ease and settle towards the rear of the field behind Drone Attack.  He added that when the pace of the race increased from the 800m he was unable to improve his position into the race for some distance as he would have preferred.
